verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official MCP server explicitly documented to let AI assistants create designs from text, edit existing designs via natural language, manage assets/brand kits, and export/resize outputs — a clear write-capable agent surface, corroborated by a dedicated MCP docs probe. This is backed further by the Connect APIs (write-capable REST API with OpenAPI/SDK generation) and Apps SDK for programmatic design manipulation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification that the MCP write operations work reliably in practice.
